inventory_method: Scanned all 18,182 installed positive realization documents for caption/publication/cutline/newsprint/newspaper/social-media context; 45 broad text hits. Read exact checked BodyReader records and decoded canonical native source for four caption-context records plus substrate/layout/place-state/participant neighbors. Reviewed matching working V3 contents; their meanings agree. Broad keyword inventory is an evidence aid, not a formal semantic-recall proof.
confusion_boundaries: Publication context is a supplied editorial relationship to an image; it changes no pixels, typography, framing or print substrate.
Text embedded in JPEG metadata is separate from pixel lettering; an external printed/web cutline can accompany a photograph without appearing in it.
A readable lower-third inside an artwork belongs to visible text/composition, not this role.
Newsprint halftone material does not establish news content, factual event history or publication status.
A functioning room or open entrance does not prove prior closure, return dates, public access, location, participant identity or affiliation.
Description/Caption differs from headline, title and accessibility alt text.
A posed portrait, archive image or topical illustration must not be interpreted as contemporaneous documentary proof of an unobserved event.
recommendations: Integrate the six proposed meanings only after source/native review; retain context-only owners and text/viewer_outcome effects.
Keep the original probe bytes unchanged for the parent-controlled before/after global search.
Inspect new retrievals for correct external-context meaning rather than workshop topic overlap; prevent visible-type or newsprint promotion into this role.

Do not infer verification from candidate adoption: supplied reporting/brief/provenance must establish every concrete fact, date and status. No image generation or source qualification was executed in this slot.

sources.title: IPTC Photo Metadata User Guide, November 2025
sources.supports: Description/Caption conveys the depicted people, action and supplied context; caption differs from accessibility alt text. Metadata headers are distinct from pixel data.

sources.title: IPTC Photo Metadata Standard 2025.1
sources.supports: Separate Description, Date Created and Event Name fields distinguish textual image description, capture date and named event.

sources.title: Associated Press: Telling the Story
sources.supports: Accuracy and nonfabrication apply to photographs and captions; captions explain posed circumstances; caption corrections are explicitly transmitted.

additional_test_intents.role_focus: Place a historical transit photograph in a current article with the capture year clearly separated from the current story date.
additional_test_intents.scene_context: The archive status is supplied by the editor; the dating information accompanies the photograph outside its pixels.

additional_test_intents.role_focus: Disclose that an interview subject posed for this portrait rather than documenting an ongoing task.
additional_test_intents.scene_context: A tool held in the portrait does not establish that the subject performed the task during capture.

additional_test_intents.role_focus: Use an illustrative landscape alongside an article while clearly distinguishing it from documentation of the specific reported incident.
additional_test_intents.scene_context: The publication brief declares illustration status; the caption is carried in article text.

native_review_risk: Discovery-only source proposals.
